interpretation: Source correctly distinguishes central Taichung 民權路 and coastal 民和路一段/二段; changing the name is unwarranted.
Old UTF-8 tiles contain target roads and 臺中市 associations. Missing source road is not supported as explanation for this named example.

Original compile lacks preprocessed administrative bounds and Taiwan-specific region/city assignment; nearest assignment is documented as best guess. This is a robustness deficiency, not proven cause of two-hour device hang.
Garmin address data has more structure than street labels; compiled global MDR/SRT sorting, map mixing and hardware search remain independent checks.
Most central addresses contain suffix 號 or repeated units, but actual r4924 parser accepts their first integer; do not falsely claim suffix alone loses every address.
NETFileReader does not reconstruct house number lists; returned RoadDef.hasHouseNumbers false is not evidence of absent actual NET house-number data.
minimum_candidate_changes: Generate administrative bounds from this same source; whitelist 22 TW-* admin_level4 roots to country TWN. For the 9 municipality/provincial-city roots use city=admin_level4; for 13 counties use city=admin_level8 township then admin_level7 fallback. Region is admin_level4. Do not use nearest hamlet keys once bounds assignment is verified.
Normalize 台中市 alias locally to 臺中市 for canonical location keys while retaining a search alias or city POI; never rename roads 民權→民和.

Create a small reversible GPX route-anchor POI set from real street coordinates and full names such as 臺中市西區民權路; use this to separate All POI lookup from address MDR lookup. It is an interim route-anchor fallback, not complete street/address repair.
unproven: Exact global street/house-number coverage beyond these roads
Full OSM completeness for every Taiwanese road or current official City Navigator replacement

national_admin_followup.note: No complete national geometry claim; missing object island names/coordinates not available locally
